messages.subject: Semi-landmarks along a curve
parts:
Good afternoon!

 

I’m interested to know if there is a function in geomorph that automatically lays semi-landmarks between fixed landmarks on a curve/edge (in 3D) – I’m thinking something similar to the buildtemplate function, in which you lay some fixed landmarks and it fills in the space with a certain number of semi-landmarks, except for a specific section of a 3D model rather than the whole thing (think iliac crest on an ilium, for example).  With both the digit.curves and define.sliders functions, if I understand correctly, all the landmarks have to be laid manually and then the sliders selected from those landmarks, so I’m interested to know if there is a more automated solution available in which a smaller number of fixed landmarks can be laid and the spaces between the fixed landmarks filled in automatically with semi-landmarks.

 

Thank you!


Sincerely,

Marla

messages.author: 4d71c6e24fb21497
messages.subject: RE: [geomorph-r-package] Semi-landmarks along a curve
parts:
You might check out the R-package StereoMorph. It has a curve digitizing function that is really quite nice. Once digitizes in a semi-automatic way, and then one can post-hoc request 10, 50, 100, 500 points to be used to represent the curve.

Dean
